concepts.name: User
concepts.definition: A registered account on the site, identified by Id or DisplayName.

concepts.name: UserReputation
concepts.definition: The reputation score accumulated by a user.

concepts.name: UserAge
concepts.definition: The age of a user in years.

concepts.name: Post
concepts.definition: A question or answer entry on the site.

concepts.name: PostScore
concepts.definition: The net score (upvotes minus downvotes) of a post.

concepts.name: PostViewCount
concepts.definition: The number of times a post has been viewed.

concepts.name: PostFavoriteCount
concepts.definition: The number of times a post has been favorited.

concepts.name: PostCreationDate
concepts.definition: The date a post was created.

concepts.name: PostClosedDate
concepts.definition: The date a post was closed; NULL means still open.

concepts.name: PostTitle
concepts.definition: The title text of a post.

concepts.name: PostOwner
concepts.definition: The user who owns a post, via OwnerUserId or OwnerDisplayName.

concepts.name: PostTag
concepts.definition: A tag attached to a post, stored in the Tags column.

concepts.name: Badge
concepts.definition: An award given to a user.

concepts.name: BadgeDate
concepts.definition: The date a badge was awarded.

concepts.name: Comment
concepts.definition: A comment left by a user on a post.

concepts.name: CommentCreationDate
concepts.definition: The timestamp when a comment was created.

concepts.name: CommentUser
concepts.definition: The user who left a comment, via UserId or UserDisplayName.

concepts.name: Vote
concepts.definition: A vote cast by a user on a post.

concepts.name: VoteCreationDate
concepts.definition: The timestamp when a vote was cast.

concepts.name: VoteUser
concepts.definition: The user who cast a vote.

concepts.name: BountyAmount
concepts.definition: The bounty amount attached to a vote.

concepts.name: PostHistoryEdit
concepts.definition: A revision/edit event recorded in post history.

concepts.name: PostHistoryUser
concepts.definition: The user who performed a post history action.

concepts.name: PostLink
concepts.definition: A link between two posts.

concepts.name: Tag
concepts.definition: A tag entity with a name and usage count.

caveats.statement: Post creation date column is misspelled as CreaionDate, not CreationDate.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate IS NOT NULL;

caveats.statement: OwnerDisplayName may be 'Community' for community-owned posts, so OwnerUserId may be NULL.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Tags are stored as a delimited string in posts.Tags, not as a separate join table.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT Tags FROM posts WHERE Tags LIKE '%<r>%' LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: ClosedDate NULL means the post is still open; non-null means closed.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ClosedDate IS NULL;

caveats.statement: BountyAmount is only populated for bounty-related votes and may be NULL otherwise.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE BountyAmount IS NULL;

caveats.statement: User Age may be NULL for many users, affecting elder-user filters.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Age IS NULL;

caveats.statement: DisplayName is not guaranteed unique across users.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DisplayName, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY DisplayName HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: PostHistoryTypeId values cover many event types; filtering only edits requires specific codes.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT PostHistoryTypeId, COUNT(*) FROM postHistory GROUP BY PostHistoryTypeId;

derived.name: ElderUserPostCount
derived.definition: Number of posts owned by users older than 65.

derived.name: UsersWithManyBadges
derived.definition: Number of users awarded more than 5 badges.

derived.name: HighReputationPostPercentage2011
derived.definition: Percentage of 2011 posts whose owners had reputation > 1000.
aliases: percentage of posts by high reputation users in 2011
derived.formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate)=2011 AND UserReputation>1000) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate)=2011) * 100

derived.name: CommunityRLanguagePercentage
derived.definition: Percentage of Community-owned posts tagged with R.
aliases: percentage of R posts by Community
derived.formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostTag='r' AND PostOwner='Community') / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostOwner='Community') * 100

derived.name: HighScoreElderUserPercentage
derived.definition: Percentage of posts with score > 5 owned by users older than 65.
aliases: percentage of high score posts by elder users
derived.formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>5 AND UserAge>65) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>5) * 100

derived.name: MostInfluentialUserHighScorePercentage
derived.definition: Percentage of posts by the highest-reputation user with score > 50.
aliases: percentage of high score posts by most influential user
derived.formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>50 AND UserReputation=MAX(UserReputation)) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE UserReputation=MAX(UserReputation)) * 100

derived.name: PostPopularity
derived.definition: Total views on a post, used to compare popularity.

derived.name: FirstVoteDate
derived.definition: Earliest vote timestamp for a user.

derived.name: FirstBadgeDate
derived.definition: Earliest badge award date for a badge name.

derived.name: PostClosedStatus
derived.definition: Whether a post is closed (non-null ClosedDate) or open (null).
derived.formula: CASE WHEN PostClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END
